1. Have you decided what your next career move will be?
2. Do you know anyone who has had second thoughts about their job or career?
a. I don't think so. In fact, most people's careers change and develop over time.
b. Not really. As a matter of fact, most of my friends love their work.
c. Yeah, I have, as a matter of fact. I'm planning on going into engineering.
d. No. As a matter of fact, nowadays most people are forced to change jobs every few years.
e. Actually, yeah. One of my friends hates his job. In fact, he's looking for something else, so ..
f. No, I haven't. In fact, I probably should start thinking about that.
